status.role: joins the ghost-story gathering and investigation

personality.summary: Sober and sardonic; he comments on the others' obvious motives and treats the investigation as a student council duty.

relationships.utakata-misogi: Vice president whom he calmly calls out.

periods.summary: Ikazuchi appears during the student council's ghost-story and poltergeist episode. He corrects Utakata's jokes, recognizes the transparent attempt by Utakata and Renren to search only the guard room, and joins the student council's broader search because he is a council member.

key_events.summary: Attends the ghost-story party and joins the night search as a student council member.
